scientific_boundary: GSE80178 within-study expression effects only; all 12 arrays are primary and n=11 excluding GSM2114233 is sensitivity only.
accepted_interpretation: No gene reaches BH FDR < 0.05 in either prespecified all-12 primary DFU contrast.
Primary and GSM2114233-exclusion sensitivity effects are globally stable across all declared feature- and gene-level contrasts.
Threshold-level significance is sample-sensitive: CBLL2 is significant only in sensitivity DFU_vs_NFS, and nine genes are significant only in the naive merged-control sensitivity contrast.
mandatory_limitations: GSM2114233 is a multi-metric QC outlier retained in the primary analysis under the author-approved route.
Unique ENTREZ mapping yield is diagnostic and limits annotation coverage.
Sensitivity-only significance must not be presented as a robust primary gene finding.
The naive merged-control contrast is sensitivity-only; DFS and NFS remain separate primary comparators.
cannot_conclude: No primary gene-level differential-expression discovery at BH FDR < 0.05 can be claimed from GSE80178.
CBLL2 or any naive-contrast sensitivity-only gene cannot be claimed as a validated DFU biomarker from M03 alone.
Internal deterministic reproduction does not establish external biological validation.
mutation_rule: Do not modify this accepted result. Any correction requires SQ2 change control and a new accepted version.
